This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 6" />

==Biology and appearance==
This large [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin, wide facial features, and pointed [[Tooth|teeth]].

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|6}}</ref> a member of this species was imprisoned aboard the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Correctional Transport|correctional transport]] ''[[Bothan-5]]''.<ref name="Chapter 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 6: The Prisoner|sixth episode]] of the [[2019]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Rick Famuyiwa]].<ref name="Chapter 6" />
